body:
The reason why the test fails is that the `reset` event is not fired in Jest 24 because it relies on jsdom 11 which has an issue with form resets ([see jsdom changelog](https://github.com/jsdom/jsdom/blob/master/Changelog.md#1310)).

This will be fixed as soon as Jest 25 is released because they'll upgrade to jsdom 15 ([see Jest changelog](https://github.com/facebook/jest/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#chore--maintenance)).
